requirements.title: SELECTED_INT_KIND applies range criterion and tie rule
requirements.definition: SELECTED_INT_KIND returns an integer kind meeting the decimal exponent range criterion, or -1 with no such kind; among multiple matches it selects the smallest decimal exponent range and then the smallest kind value.

pending.SELECTED_INT_KIND-range-criterion: Use K=SELECTED_INT_KIND(18), relying on 7.4.3.1 p2 for availability, declare INTEGER(KIND=K), assert K>0 and RANGE(value)>=18, and mutate R to a larger unguaranteed value in a source-control mutant only.
pending.SELECTED_INT_KIND-negative-and-zero-same: Assert SELECTED_INT_KIND(-1)==SELECTED_INT_KIND(0), with both results initialized through distinct sentinels, and mutate the zero argument to 18.
pending.SELECTED_INT_KIND-tie-rule: No portable independent oracle exists for the exact numeric kind value chosen by the full tie rule across processor-private integer kind inventories; future fixtures verify guaranteed availability and returned-kind RANGE properties only.
